    after automatic semicolon insertion lead to syntax error

es5id: 7.9_A5.7_T1
description: Try use Variable1 \n ++ \n ++ \n Variable2 construction
negative:
  phase: parse
  type: SyntaxError
---*/

var z=
x
++
++
